tools.name: search_calculators
tools.description: Search the LogicCommons calculator catalog by keyword and optional category. Returns matching published calculators with slug, name, summary, category, a citation URL, and trust metadata.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "run_calculator" stacks urgency/override words (always, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_calculator, search_calculators · Public sink: get_calculator_schema · Destructive: run_calculator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_calculator, search_calculators · Public sink: get_calculator_schema · Destructive: run_calculator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
